passed_checks.check_name: Ensure AWS IAM policy does not allow assume role permission across all services
code_block:
LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: LogsWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/order-processor:*
        - PolicyName: SQSPollPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SQSPollSpecificQueue
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                Resource: !GetAtt OrdersQueue.Arn
              - Sid: SQSGetQueueUrl
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:GetQueueUrl
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: order-processor

passed_checks.check_name: Ensure Lambda Runtime is not deprecated
code_block:
OrderProcessorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: order-processor
      Description: Processes order messages from SQS.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: app.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        S3Bucket: !Ref CodeS3Bucket
        S3Key: !Ref CodeS3Key
        S3ObjectVersion: !If [HasCodeObjectVersion, !Ref CodeS3ObjectVersion, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      MemorySize: !Ref LambdaMemorySize
      Timeout: !Ref LambdaTimeout
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      ReservedConcurrentExecutions: !Ref LambdaReservedConcurrency
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LOG_LEVEL: INFO
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: order-processor
